items.name: Island chicken plate
items.description: Caribbean-leaning chicken plate with rice and sides on the waterfront patio.
items.verdict: The best counter lunch at the park. Eat it on the patio between the morning coasters and the afternoon shows.

items.name: Tropical freeze drink
items.description: Frozen tropical slush from the waterfront grill — hydration and dessert in one queue-portable cup.
items.verdict: The correct Florida coaster-park drink: cold, shareable, and carried one-handed through the Mako queue.

items.name: Cobbler
items.description: Warm fruit cobbler from the lagoon-edge cookhouse, eaten at the splash-view tables.
items.verdict: A genuine dessert rather than a freezer case. Order it, take the splash-view table, let the flume do the dinner theater.
